social.title: Jazz Night at Cliff Bell's
social.description: Slide into a red leather booth at this fully restored 1930s art-deco club for a set of live jazz most nights of the week.
social.bonus: Stay for the whole set without checking your phone.

social.title: Weekend Live Music at Cafe d'Mongo's Speakeasy
social.description: Squeeze into this tiny, legendary downtown speakeasy for live music, strong drinks, and decades of stories.
social.bonus: Ask the bartender for the story behind something on the wall.

social.title: Rooftop Cocktails at The Monarch Club
social.description: Ride to the 13th floor of the historic Metropolitan building for skyline views in every direction and a serious cocktail menu.
social.bonus: Ask the bartender for their favorite drink not on the menu.

social.title: Watch the Game at Nemo's Bar
social.description: Pack into this Corktown institution near the old Tiger Stadium site to watch Detroit sports with a room full of true believers.
social.bonus: High-five a stranger the next time Detroit scores.

social.title: Live Music Night at PJ's Lager House
social.description: Catch a touring or local band on the small stage at this Corktown dive that's been hosting live music since 1914.
social.bonus: Talk to the band after their set.

social.title: Rock-N-Bowl at Garden Bowl
social.description: Bowl a few frames at America's oldest operating alley, tucked inside the Majestic Theatre complex since 1913.
social.bonus: Bowl one frame with your non-dominant hand.

social.title: Salsa Night at Vicente's Cuban Cuisine
social.description: Take a free salsa lesson and stay for the dancing at this downtown Cuban restaurant's Friday and Saturday night tradition.
social.bonus: Ask someone you don't know to be your dance partner.

social.title: Live Jazz at Baker's Keyboard Lounge
social.description: Take a seat at the world's oldest continuously operating jazz club, freshly restored piano-shaped bar and all.
social.bonus: Ask a regular how many years they've been coming here.

social.title: Find the Hidden Door at Bad Luck Bar
social.description: Knock to get into this locked, low-lit speakeasy and settle in for experimental cocktails you won't find anywhere else downtown.
social.bonus: Order the drink with the strangest name on the menu.

social.title: Techno Night at Marble Bar
social.description: Post up on the patio or the dance floor at this intimate house-and-techno venue with a sound system built for the genre.
social.bonus: Ask the DJ what track just played.

social.title: Catch a Show at El Club
social.description: See a touring band at this Southwest Detroit venue Rolling Stone named one of the best rooms in the country.
social.bonus: Buy the opener's merch, not just the headliner's.

social.title: Dance Till Close at TV Lounge
social.description: Sink into Detroit's longest-running dance club, where the sound system's built for house and techno till the sun's basically up.
social.bonus: Compliment a stranger's dance moves before the night's over.

adventure.title: Dinner Cruise on the Detroit Princess Riverboat
adventure.description: Glide past two countries' skylines on the Midwest's largest dinner cruise boat while a live band keeps the dance floor moving.
adventure.bonus: Get a stranger to dance with you before the boat docks.

adventure.title: Pickup Pickleball at Beacon Park
adventure.description: Grab a paddle and jump into open play on Beacon Park's downtown courts, no membership required.
adventure.bonus: Play a game with someone you've never met.

adventure.title: Cheer on the Pistons at Little Caesars Arena
adventure.description: Grab a seat in the upper bowl and watch Detroit basketball live under the arena lights.
adventure.bonus: Stay through the final buzzer even in a blowout.

adventure.title: Hatchet Throwing at Detroit Axe
adventure.description: Grab a hatchet and stick a bullseye in Corktown's dedicated axe-throwing lanes inside The Yard.
adventure.bonus: Bet a round of drinks on the next throw.

adventure.title: Free Architecture Tour of the Fisher & Guardian Buildings
adventure.description: Follow a local guide through two Art Deco masterpieces most people just walk past on their lunch break.
adventure.bonus: Tip your guide in cash even though the tour is free.

adventure.title: Guest Day Pass Workout at the Boll Family YMCA
adventure.description: Buy a day pass to downtown's full-service YMCA and get a real workout in between exploring the city.
adventure.bonus: Try a piece of equipment you've never used before.

adventure.title: Kayak Rental at Belle Isle's Flynn Pavilion
adventure.description: Paddle out onto the Detroit River from Belle Isle's boat livery with skyline views on one side and Canada on the other.
adventure.bonus: Paddle out until you can't hear traffic anymore.

adventure.title: Haunted Downtown Ghost Walk
adventure.description: Wind through downtown Detroit's oldest alleys and lobbies as a guide unearths the city's darkest stories after dark.
adventure.bonus: Ask the guide which stop actually creeps them out.

adventure.title: Indoor Pickleball at Court4 Detroit
adventure.description: Book a court inside Detroit's dedicated indoor pickleball dome and get a real game in no matter the weather.
adventure.bonus: Play left-handed for one full game if you're a righty.

adventure.title: Crack the Code at Escape the Room Detroit
adventure.description: Lock yourself in with your crew and race the clock to solve a room full of puzzles before time runs out.
adventure.bonus: Let the quietest person in your group call the final answer.

adventure.title: Great Migration Tour at Michigan Central Station
adventure.description: Trace the journey of Black Detroiters who reshaped the city on a 75-minute specialty tour departing from the station's Graffiti Foyer.
adventure.bonus: Ask your guide for one story that isn't on the official plaque.

adventure.title: Catch a Detroit Tigers Game at Comerica Park
adventure.description: Grab cheap seats, split a ballpark hot dog, and cheer under the lights at one of baseball's most fan-friendly stadiums.
adventure.bonus: Try to catch a foul ball, even from the cheap seats.

adventure.title: Behind-the-Scenes Tour of Michigan Central Station
adventure.description: Walk the restored grand hall of Detroit's century-old train station on a guided 90-minute tour through its jaw-dropping revival.
adventure.bonus: Snap a photo in the exact spot from the station's most famous old postcard.

adventure.title: Catch a Detroit Lions Game at Ford Field
adventure.description: Pack into Ford Field's roaring crowd for an NFL Sunday and feel the whole stadium shake on a big third down.
adventure.bonus: Learn the fight song before kickoff.

adventure.title: Sunset Bike Ride on the RiverWalk & Dequindre Cut
adventure.description: Rent a bike from Wheelhouse Detroit and ride the full connected loop of riverfront and greenway as the sky turns pink.
adventure.bonus: Ride the whole loop without stopping to check your phone.

adventure.title: Free Community Yoga on Belle Isle
adventure.description: Roll out a mat on the grass for a free, drop-in outdoor yoga class as part of the city's summer parks program.
adventure.bonus: Skip the mat and just use a towel, no excuses.

adventure.title: Ice Skate at The Rink at Campus Martius
adventure.description: Lace up on the nation's top-rated outdoor rink and circle the ice under downtown Detroit's skyline lights.
adventure.bonus: Skate one full lap holding hands with someone you just met.

adventure.title: Detroit Historical Canal Tour by Kayak
adventure.description: Paddle a guided two-hour route from Maheras-Gentry Park out to the Detroit River and through the historic canals of Little Venice.
adventure.bonus: Ask your guide to point out the old Purple Gang hideouts.

adventure.title: Wander the Heidelberg Project
adventure.description: Walk two blocks of found-object art and polka-dotted houses that turned a struggling street into an open-air museum.
adventure.bonus: Find the piece that makes you the most uncomfortable and sit with why.

adventure.title: Guided Riverwalk Bike Tour with Wheelhouse Detroit
adventure.description: Pedal the full stretch of the Detroit RiverWalk with a local guide pointing out landmarks you'd otherwise ride right past.
adventure.bonus: Ride the whole loop without checking your phone once.

adventure.title: City Glow Yoga at Campus Martius Park
adventure.description: Flow through a glowing, neon-headphone silent-disco yoga class in the middle of downtown with a DJ spinning live.
adventure.bonus: Keep your eyes closed for one full song.

adventure.title: Ride the Giant Slide on Belle Isle
adventure.description: Climb the fire-truck-red steel slide on Belle Isle and fly down thirty feet of pure childhood adrenaline.
adventure.bonus: Go down backwards at least once.

adventure.title: Morning Run Along Belle Isle's Riverside Loop
adventure.description: Log a few miles on Belle Isle's flat riverside road loop with downtown Detroit and Windsor trading skylines the whole way.
adventure.bonus: Run the loop without your headphones in.

foodie.title: Vietnamese Dinner at Flowers of Vietnam
foodie.description: Dig into bold, Michigan-grown Vietnamese cooking inside a converted Mexicantown coney island turned destination restaurant.

foodie.title: East African Feast at Baobab Fare
foodie.description: Share a table over Burundian and East African dishes at this New Center restaurant built by a husband-and-wife team of refugees turned restaurateurs.
foodie.bonus: Ask the staff to tell you the story behind the restaurant's name.

foodie.title: Pizza & Bocce at Ottava Via
foodie.description: Split a brick-oven pizza on the patio, then challenge your table to a round on the restaurant's own bocce court.
foodie.bonus: Loser buys the next round of Aperol spritzes.

foodie.title: Thai Dinner at Takoi
foodie.description: Feast on big-flavor, farm-fed Thai plates and inventive cocktails at Corktown's toughest reservation to land.
foodie.bonus: Order the dish the menu calls the spiciest and finish it.

foodie.title: Saturday Morning at Eastern Market
foodie.description: Weave through vendor stalls at one of the country's oldest public markets, sampling produce, flowers, and fresh-baked everything.
foodie.bonus: Buy something from a vendor you've never bought from before.

foodie.title: Coney Dog Showdown: American vs. Lafayette
foodie.description: Order the same coney at both century-old, side-by-side rivals on Lafayette Boulevard and settle the debate for yourself.
foodie.bonus: Pick a side and defend it loudly to a stranger in line.

foodie.title: Butcher's Brasserie Dinner at Marrow in the Market
foodie.description: Dig into a farm-to-table dinner at the James Beard-nominated butcher shop turned brasserie in the heart of Eastern Market.
foodie.bonus: Ask your server what cut you've never tried and order it.

foodie.title: Distillery Flight at Two James Spirits
foodie.description: Sample a flight of Detroit's first post-Prohibition-era spirits inside the tasting room where they're actually made.
foodie.bonus: Ask the bartender to build you something off-menu.

foodie.title: Brewery Lunch at Batch Brewing Company
foodie.description: Post up in Corktown's original craft brewery for house-made beer and a pretzel the size of your head.
foodie.bonus: Order the flight and let a stranger at the bar pick your favorite.

foodie.title: Dinner at Selden Standard
foodie.description: Settle into Detroit's most celebrated New American kitchen for wood-fired, seasonal plates built for sharing.
foodie.bonus: Order whatever the server says is their personal favorite.

foodie.title: Container-Hopping at Detroit Shipping Company
foodie.description: Bounce between a half-dozen independent kitchens stacked inside repurposed shipping containers under one open-air roof.
foodie.bonus: Order from the vendor with the shortest line, on principle.

foodie.title: Dinner at Grey Ghost
foodie.description: Pull up a seat at this Brush Park neighborhood favorite for elevated comfort food and a serious cocktail list.
foodie.bonus: Let the bartender pick your drink with zero input from you.

chill.title: Explore Dabl's MBAD African Bead Museum
chill.description: Walk an entire city block of outdoor mosaics and mirror installations built by artist Olayami Dabls to connect Detroit to African history.
chill.bonus: Ask a docent to explain the meaning behind one installation.

chill.title: Browse the Stacks at John K. King Books
chill.description: Get lost for an hour in four floors of a former glove factory stuffed with over a million used and rare books.
chill.bonus: Buy the first book whose cover catches your eye, no research allowed.

chill.title: Flip Through Vinyl at Third Man Records
chill.description: Dig through crates at Jack White's Cass Corridor record store and watch vinyl get pressed live through the viewing windows.
chill.bonus: Buy an album by an artist you've never heard of.

chill.title: Picnic at the James Scott Memorial Fountain
chill.description: Spread a blanket by Belle Isle's grand marble fountain and watch the Detroit River drift by from the island's front lawn.
chill.bonus: Leave your phone in the bag for the whole picnic.

chill.title: Full-Day Ceramics Intensive at Pewabic Pottery
chill.description: Spend a full day immersed in wheel-throwing and glazing techniques at the storied studio behind Detroit's iconic architectural tile.
chill.bonus: Give your finished piece to someone instead of keeping it.

chill.title: Beginner Pottery Class at Pewabic Pottery
chill.description: Get your hands in the clay at Detroit's century-old ceramic studio, taught by working artists in a National Historic Landmark.
chill.bonus: Keep whatever shape it turns into, mistakes and all.

chill.title: Walk the Dequindre Cut Greenway
chill.description: Stroll the sunken rail-trail's mural-lined path connecting Eastern Market to the riverfront without crossing a single street.
chill.bonus: Find your favorite piece of graffiti and look up the artist later.

chill.title: Glass-Domed Escape at the Belle Isle Conservatory
chill.description: Step into the century-old Anna Scripps Whitcomb Conservatory and thaw out among palms, orchids, and a koi-filled lily pond.
chill.bonus: Find the strangest-looking plant in the whole conservatory.

chill.title: Sunset Walk Along the Detroit RiverWalk
chill.description: Follow the paved path along the water as the sun drops behind the Ambassador Bridge and the skyline lights flicker on.
chill.bonus: Stop at a bench and watch a full sunset without walking.

chill.title: Slow Coffee Morning at Anthology Coffee
chill.description: Post up with a single-origin pour-over at this small-batch roaster and let the morning move at its own pace.
chill.bonus: Order whatever bean the barista is most excited about.

chill.title: Stroll Milliken State Park & Harbor
chill.description: Wander Michigan's first urban state park, a 31-acre pocket of wetlands and paved trails tucked right along the Detroit River.
chill.bonus: Sit on the harbor wall until you spot a boat go by.

chill.title: Wander the Detroit Institute of Arts
chill.description: Lose an afternoon in the DIA's world-class galleries, from Diego Rivera's murals to armor rooms straight out of a fantasy novel.
chill.bonus: Find the one piece you'd steal if you could get away with it.
